title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
slides: Cyera buys Oasis Security to fill a gap.
Most agents still ship with zero protection.
Your AI workforce now has a safety net.
Audit every agent's identity before deployment.
thread_text:
1. $1B still not enough?

Cyera just spent $1B acquiring Oasis Security to patch a critical gap: most AI agents ship with zero protection.

2. The missing layer

Agent identity is the blind spot. Without it, attackers can impersonate your AI workforce.

3. No audit, no safety

Deploy an agent today — it likely has no security checks. That’s the default.

4. Safety net arrives

Oasis brings identity verification for agents. Now every AI actor can be tracked before it acts.

5. Audit your next agent

Take one agent you plan to deploy this week. Can you verify its identity before it runs?
